tests.title: Task 1: Internet and landline use in Vietnam

content.prompt_md:
The table below shows the percentage of the population using the internet and the percentage with landline telephone subscriptions in Vietnam between 2005 and 2023.

| Year | Internet users | Landline subscriptions |
|------|---------------|------------------------|
| 2005 | 10% | 30% |
| 2011 | 35% | 20% |
| 2017 | 58% | 9% |
| 2023 | 79% | 4% |

**Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.**

Write at least 150 words.

questions.prompt: Write your report in response to the task above. You should spend about 20 minutes on this task.
